originalTitle: Madhusudan Kela’s portfolio: 7 stocks rally up to 135% in CY26
simplifiedContent: Madhusudan Kela, an investor, has a portfolio of 19 stocks that are currently worth around Rs 2,665 crore. Some of the stocks he owns have done very well, with 7 of them increasing in value by 10-135% this year. On the other hand, 5 of his stocks have lost value, decreasing by 15-30%. This shows that his portfolio has had both big wins and losses, with some stocks performing much better than others. This matters because it highlights the ups and downs of investing in the stock market, even for experienced investors like Madhusudan Kela.

originalTitle: Bitcoin near $63,000 as weaker ETF demand and cancelled SEC meeting dampen crypto sentiment
simplifiedContent: The price of Bitcoin is currently around $63,000. This is because some investors are losing interest in investing in Bitcoin through something called an ETF, and a meeting with a important government group (the SEC) was cancelled. As a result, people are feeling less excited about investing in cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum, and their prices are going down. The total value of all cryptocurrencies is also decreasing, by about 0.4%. This matters because it shows that investors are getting a bit less confident in the cryptocurrency market.

originalTitle: F&O Talk: Nifty consolidation to continue says Sudeep Shah; gives Tata Motors, Lenskart, Honasa strategy
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the stock market news: The Nifty, a major stock market index, is not moving much and is expected to stay that way. This means it's likely to stay within a certain range, between 24,150 and 24,600. The fact that volatility is decreasing and there are many "put writings" (a type of trade) suggests that the market doesn't expect the Nifty to go down much. Analysts think some areas, like government-owned banks, defence, auto, and chemicals, are looking strong. This information can help investors make decisions about where to put their money.

originalTitle: Buy or sell: Ganesh Dongre of Anand Rathi recommends 3 stocks to buy on Monday - 17 August 2026
simplifiedContent: There's tension in the Middle East that's affecting the Indian stock market. Despite this, a market expert named Ganesh Dongre from Anand Rathi is suggesting that investors buy certain stocks on Monday, August 17, 2026. He has picked three specific stocks that he thinks are good to buy. This matters because it could be a chance for investors to make some money, even when the market is uncertain. Ganesh Dongre's recommendations might be helpful for investors who are looking for guidance on what to do with their money.

originalTitle: US-Iran war to crude oil prices: Top five triggers that may dictate the Indian stock market this week
simplifiedContent: Last week, the Indian stock market had a small decrease, with the Sensex falling 0.62% and the Nifty falling 0.83%. This week, some of the same global events that affected the market last week will continue to have an impact. There are also some new factors that will influence the market this week. These factors, or "triggers", will help determine how the stock market performs. Investors should pay attention to these triggers to understand what might happen to the market this week.

originalTitle: Alphabet made 100x on SpaceX, now Nvidia reveals $21 billion stake: Why Musk’s AI push matters
simplifiedContent: Alphabet, the company that owns Google, invested $900 million in a company called SpaceX a while back. That investment is now worth $94 billion, which is a huge increase. Another company, Nvidia, also has a significant investment in SpaceX, worth $21 billion. This matters because SpaceX is growing its business in artificial intelligence (AI) and infrastructure, which is an important area of technology. This growth and investment in SpaceX shows that big companies believe in the potential of AI and are putting their money into it.
